name: What kind of inspections are essential for a waterfront home?

mainEntity.name: What kind of inspections are essential for a waterfront home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Beyond a standard home inspection, waterfront homes require specialized inspections. These include marine inspections for seawalls, docks, and boat lifts to assess their structural integrity and maintenance needs. A comprehensive survey should also verify property lines relative to the water. Additionally, a flood elevation certificate is critical for insurance purposes. These detailed inspections help ensure you understand the full condition of the property you're considering.
acceptedAnswer.description: Essential inspections for waterfront homes include marine inspections for seawalls, docks, and boat lifts, plus a flood elevation certificate.
